task: Compare business class flight options from Lisbon to Singapore for a one-way trip on July 15, 2027, select one of the flights and see which websites offer its booking options. Which one is the cheapest.
answer:
FINAL: Gotogate is the cheapest booking website listed for the selected Finnair business-class flight, at €2,205—€9 less than booking through Finnair or Expedia.

Search: one-way, 1 adult, Business, Lisbon (LIS) → Singapore (SIN), departing July 15, 2027. Prices checked October 27, 2026 in EUR.

Flight comparison from Google Flights, Cheapest tab, sorted by price:
- LOT/SriLankan: €1,969; 45 hr 25 min; three stops; self transfer. This was the lowest search result.
- British Airways/Finnair: €2,017; 24 hr 25 min; two stops via London Heathrow and Helsinki.
- Finnair: €2,205; 18 hr 55 min; one stop in Helsinki. Selected for its shorter journey and single connection.
- SWISS/Singapore Airlines: €2,694; 17 hr 25 min; one stop in Zürich.

Selected itinerary: Finnair AY1740 + AY131, departing Lisbon at 16:35 on July 15 and arriving Singapore at 18:30 on July 16, 2027. Helsinki connection: 1 hr 20 min. Both segments show Business Class.

Booking websites and displayed prices for this itinerary:
| Website | Price |

| Gotogate | €2,205 (RSD 259,022 on Gotogate) |
| Finnair | €2,214 |
| Expedia | €2,214 |
